thread:
Priya K.: Kicking off Sable onboarding — quick sync. Our goals: get integration passing, pilot with 3 internal flows by end of month, and validation criteria for renewal readiness. Who's owning infra, training, and feedback capture?
Marco Rivera: I can own infra + deployment validation. plan to run perf baseline next Wed. need env creds from Sable.
Aisha Patel: I'll lead enablement (docs + training sessions). tentatively schedule two 45m workshops for engineers + PMs.
Liam Chen: I'll take product acceptance tests and eval sets. can we confirm target eval prompts?
Nora Blake: I'll be CS lead on account side. primary contacts at Sable: Ryan (CTO), Mei (Lead Eng), and Jordan (Ops). I'll intro later today.
Priya K.: Thanks. Key success criteria I'm proposing: 1) pilot DAG completes in <= 120s for end-to-end, 2) model p95 latency < 300ms in dedicated staging for typical inputs, 3) accuracy/regression delta <= 3% vs baseline, 4) onboarding checklist done + enablement signoff. thoughts?
Marco Rivera: latency target ok but call out tokenized vs end-to-end numbers. I suggest p95 inference < 250ms on dedicated nodes, E2E <120s still stands.
Liam Chen: Accuracy delta — can we pin to specific evaluation set? will draft. Also need schema for feedback capture: structured form + weekly survey.
Aisha Patel: For workshops: two sessions — "integration & auth" and "prompts & tuning". I'll draft slides and a hands-on lab. prefer Wed + Thu next week.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: created onboarding doc https://redwood.company/sable-onboard (private). Everyone with access: Priya K., Marco Rivera, Aisha Patel, Liam Chen, Nora Blake.
Nora Blake: Ryan asked about renewal milestones early. We should capture risk signals: slow pilot progress, repeated integration issues, and missed enablement sessions. propose biweekly health checks with exec summary sent to Ryan.
Priya K.: Good point. Let's define risk thresholds in the doc. low/medium/high buckets and owners to remediate.
Marco Rivera: Technical risks: creds delay, rate limits, tokenization mismatch. I'll add a risk mitigation section and fallback plan (use lower-throughput dedicated pool).
Liam Chen: Feedback capture plan: in-app feedback + weekly synthesis. We'll keep a scoreboard: top 5 failure modes + comment trends.
Aisha Patel: Will schedule training invites today. can someone confirm the engineer attendee list from Sable?
Nora Blake: I'll intro now in email and ping here when it's sent.
Priya K.: Rough timeline: week 0 (this week) align stakeholders + env setup; week 1 perf baselines + workshops; week 2 pilot runs + iterate; week 3 acceptance + handoff to ops. Aim to have renewal-ready signals by week 4.
Marco Rivera: Confirm infra tasks: provision staging cluster, share endpoint + creds, run baseline script. I'll put commands in the doc.
Liam Chen: Baseline script snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"perf test prompt"}'
```
Aisha Patel: Quick ask — can we get a short FAQ for Sable's PMs about expected performance and SLAs? I'll draft and share.
Nora Blake: Action: i'll do account intro + confirm Sable attendees (today). Marco: infra baseline by next Wed. Aisha: workshop invites by EOD. Liam: eval prompts + feedback schema by Friday. Priya: compile success criteria + risk thresholds in doc.
Priya K.: Thanks all. I'll update the onboarding doc with these action items and ping when done. :raised_hands:
